'''Burner''' was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Adventures" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Burner is the third [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] to be created specifically for [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], not appearing at all in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' series]], alongside [[Breaker]] and [[Cards]]. Clone commando [[Racket]] follows as the fourth.<ref name="Adventures" />
